title: Fuzzy Green Cardigan & Denim Maxi
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark brown hair and a small hair clip stands with her arms folded against a gray concrete wall. She wears a sage green ribbed knit crop top with a fuzzy faux-fur shawl collar and cuffs. A distressed dark wash denim maxi skirt with a front slit and frayed hem sits low, with a black belt and a silver buckle. Black pointed-toe ankle boots with buckle straps complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even light. Palette of sage, faded denim, and charcoal. Cozy and textured, in the style of an autumn street-style editorial.
workingNotes:
- The fuzzy shawl collar and denim slit skirt are the signature details.
- Keep the concrete wall for an industrial, gritty backdrop.
